meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 对代码库做 9 个维度的技术债体检:架构、类型、测试、安全等,每条发现都注明 file:line:col,最后在仓库根目录生成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,内含严重度分级、工时估算和按优先级排的修复清单。
howto.when: 当你要求做技术债审计、架构审查或清理规划时触发;提到 “tech debt”、“code health” 等关键词也会接管。超过约 5 万行的代码库会把较重的维度分给并行子代理处理。

say.text: 审计一下这个仓库的技术债,输出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md

howto.what_en: Runs a 9-dimension tech debt audit: architecture, types, tests, security, and more. Every finding cites file:line:col, and it writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md at the repo root with severity, hour estimates, and ranked fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a tech debt audit, architecture review, or cleanup planning, or mention keywords like 'tech debt' or 'code health'. Codebases over ~50k LOC get parallel sub-agents.

say_en.text: Audit this repo for tech debt and write TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say_en.note: Generates a report citing file:line:col for every finding
